name: unaverage-design
description: Studio-level design for anything visual, aiming for results that look like a top studio made them, not like generic AI design. For startups and marketing, B2B and B2C: websites, landing pages, product UI, app screens, dashboards, AI chat interfaces, pitch and sales decks, presentations, social posts, carousels, ads, emails, one-pagers, reports, infographics, posters, trade fair, logo and brand, HTML pages or artifacts. Recommends three ranked directions, lets you pick the effort (Quick, Standard, Studio), builds mockups to choose from and checks with measurement and independent reviewers. Writes English and German copy. Use whenever something visual is made or revised, also for 'does this look generic', 'looks like AI', 'make it premium', 'design check', or in German 'wirkt das generisch', 'sieht das nach KI aus', 'mach das hochwertiger', 'Landingpage', 'Präsentation'. Brand, CI and format skills take precedence for colors, fonts and logo. Not for plain text or video.
